name: Unsafe Stairs OLD
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
description: The rickety stairs groan and strain alarmingly if a Small or larger creature ascends them.
disable: DC 16 Crafting to quickly jury-rig some supports to prevent the stairs from collapsing

generalAbilities.name: Collapse
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A Small or larger creature attempts to climb the stairs;

Effect The stairs attempt a Basic DC 8 Flat (if a Small creature triggered the hazard) or a Basic DC 16 Flat (if a Medium or multiple Small creatures triggered it). On a failure, the stairs collapse. All creatures on the stairs fall and take (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning Damage damage from the collapsing rubble (Basic DC 16 Reflex Saving Throw).
